title: Purchase Protection Reimbursement Amount — Pocketwire Personal Account
content:
**Article 1 — Form of payment.** Purchase protection claims on a Pocketwire Personal Account carry no customer liability and no provisional credit; the claims team records approved or denied, and an approval is paid as one reimbursement entry pointing to the disputed payment, whose amount is the protection reimbursement and which already includes any credit card funding fee part, so no separate fee refund is booked for that payment.

**Article 2 — The claim paid.** The claim paid is the purchase protection claim most recently approved on the account — the approved claim with the latest approval date — and it is paid once: a claim whose disputed payment already carries a reimbursement entry is not paid again.

**Article 3 — The reimbursement.** The protection reimbursement is the covered amount capped at the protection ceiling, which is the plan's purchase protection maximum reimbursable amount, never below 0.00 and rounded to the cent (half up) once, at the end. Any coverage share applying to the claim multiplies the covered amount first, any delay credit is then added to that result, and only this figure is compared with the protection ceiling as raised by any multiplier on it.

**Article 4 — The covered amount.** The covered amount is the claim amount as filed, plus the credit card funding fee booked on the disputed payment in the same proportion as the claim amount bears to the payment amount (rounded to the cent, half up; nothing when no such fee was booked), less the money the customer received from the seller's username, personal payments counting in full and goods-and-services payments counting net of the seller fee at the plan's goods-and-services seller fee rate (rounded to the cent, half up).

- The seller's username is the recipient the disputed payment was sent to; every payment the account has received from that username is counted.
- The goods-and-services payments received from that username are totalled, and the total net of the seller fee rate is rounded once.

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A 300.00 goods-and-services payment funded by a linked credit card carried a 9.00 credit card funding fee. The claim amount as filed is 200.00. The seller's username had sent the customer a personal payment of 20.00 and a goods-and-services payment of 50.00. The plan's seller fee rate is taken as 2.99 percent and its ceiling as 500.00.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Funding fee part: 9.00 times 200.00 divided by 300.00 | 6.00 |
| Money back: 20.00 in full, plus 50.00 net of 2.99 percent (48.505, rounded to 48.51) | 68.51 |
| Covered amount: 200.00 plus 6.00 less 68.51 | 137.49 |
| Compared with the ceiling of 500.00 | 137.49 |

Other hypothetical outcomes: a covered amount of 3000.00 against a ceiling of 2500.00 is paid as 2500.00; a covered amount below 0.00 (money back larger than the claim) is paid as 0.00.
